evals.name: verify-provisional-config-against-ci
evals.prompt: Run /sdlc-init. The repo has a provisional .agents/sdlc.config.json (trunk, main, no gates) and a .github/workflows/ci.yml that runs `pnpm -r lint`, `pnpm -r typecheck` and `pnpm -r test` on pull requests into develop. There is a develop branch.
evals.expected_output: Detects the two-trunk model from the develop branch and PR target, rewrites the config with production main and integration develop, adds the three gates with the commands copied exactly from CI (pnpm -r …) in cheapest-first order, keeps the three CI gates blocking and records their enforcement on the host as unverified (partial in critical-infrastructure.md) unless branch protection was checked, removes _provisional only after verification, fills the AGENTS.md commands, and reports each value as detected/asked/assumed with ranked gaps and one next action.
expectations: Changes the branch model to two-trunk with develop as integration
Gate commands match the CI run lines character for character (pnpm -r ...)
Keeps the CI gates blocking: true, and does not claim the host enforces them without checking branch protection
Reports values as detected, asked or assumed
Ends the report with a single next action

evals.name: overlays-not-copies
evals.prompt: Set up the SDLC for this Next.js + Prisma repo. Note it uses SWR for data fetching, Mantine for UI, and tests run with `pnpm vitest run`.
evals.expected_output: Writes overlays for the relevant kit skills (frontend: SWR + Mantine conventions and the single-test command; backend: Prisma generate/migrate commands) instead of copying or editing kit skills, and does not generate project skills that duplicate gates/ship-it/handoff.
expectations: Does not edit files under .agents/skills/<kit skill>/
Does not generate a project skill that duplicates the kit's gates, ship-it or handoff skills

evals.name: unverified-protection-keeps-gates-blocking
evals.prompt: Run /sdlc-init. The repo has no git remote yet. Its .github/workflows/ci.yml runs `npm run lint`, `npm test` and `npm run build` on pull requests into main, with no continue-on-error.
evals.expected_output: Adds the three gates with the CI commands, all blocking: true, because a failing check is a failure whether or not the host enforces it. Records that branch protection could not be checked (no remote) as an enforcement gap, partial in critical-infrastructure.md, and names protecting main on the host as the next action. Never marks a gate advisory because its enforcement is unverified.
expectations: The lint, test and build gates are blocking: true
Says branch protection could not be verified, without claiming the host enforces the gates
Records the unverified enforcement as a gap (partial) rather than by making the gates advisory

evals.name: pr-per-task-host-settings
evals.prompt: Run /sdlc-init. The team wants every change to be its own pull request, opened when work starts, so everyone sees what is in flight; the agent may merge once checks pass. (The GitHub repository allows merge commits only, and does not delete branches after merge.)
evals.expected_output: Writes workflow.pullRequests: "per-task" with askMerge false, then checks the host's merge settings and reports two gaps: without squash merges each task's start commit stays in history, and without automatic branch deletion merged branches pile up — naming the setting to change for each, as the admin's call rather than changing the host itself.
expectations: Sets workflow.pullRequests to "per-task" and leaves askMerge false
Checks the repository's merge settings on the host
Reports the missing squash merge and the missing automatic branch deletion as gaps
Does not change the host's settings itself
